name: What are common signs of a hidden kitchen leak?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of a hidden kitchen leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hidden kitchen leaks often manifest as subtle changes before becoming major issues. Look for discoloration or warping on cabinetry, bubbling or peeling paint on walls, a musty odor near the sink or dishwasher, or unexplained increases in your water bill. Addressing these signs early can prevent significant water damage and mold growth. As a practical tradeoff, waiting to investigate these subtle signs can lead to more extensive and costly repairs later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs include discolored cabinets, bubbling paint, musty smells, or a higher water bill.
